notes.title: Custom game update - Building a character
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/451e7e11ff196deaa4bbb9ec2f8ce84bf48feedc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Custom games update - Build your character![/h1]
Full patch notes [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/492150/discussions/0/1744480332711780741/]>>here<<[/url]
The first stage in creating unique games following the story of your own characters has been completed, you can now build your player inside Character Creator and then set them to be used in your game! 

You can also choose which class they will be. People playing your game will be the character you chose, level 1 and have an empty inventory. Items collected will be kept only within your game and are saved when they exit. Weapons collected and used look like they normally do, however, your character will keep their look no matter what armour is worn. You only need to set the character to be used in the first world of your game, not any worlds that are connected, your character remains the one being used until the player returns to the Hub World.

To change the character and access future custom game settings press the following button in the editor. Here you'll be able to set the class and choose from saved character creator creations.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/713b4c2917ed14b3ec89dec1a215f563e9090517.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/64ee27e03dbfb32b4bae36e64acb369327d0cd7a.jpg[/img]

[h1]New  editor updates[/h1]
A lot more items now use the editor stacking system, including things like walls and trees.

There's also some large scale new items added to the buildings tab if you own the Creative Pack DLC. A chained floating island, which you can build upon (add a local portal to get up there :D).
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/09ac00342977fc0f067c9afa92c09e5a2c5f2c98.jpg[/img]

Chained magical rocks
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/5ff4f04357e1969b5f05a17bf9e2ddb2d4997f1e.jpg[/img]

Finally some classic evil towers.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/237715ca5121e34f7c3e3efeff5f08017d258119.jpg[/img]

Have a great Christmas, we'll see you in the new year!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/ffa7fae7adb6972b9f7b8cae9518876800cc5dbe.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Patch!
notes.content:
[h1]Latest Patch: Growing up![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/de83a746488cfed5fd92a17f22f66fe0e8f0cf62.jpg[/img]

The patch today includes bringing the game engine RPG World runs on up to date with the latest version, which boosts performance when doing anything in RPG World. We have been wanting to update for a long time but put it off because of the amount of work, but here we are, all new and shiny.

I am currently working on the first stage of opening up the creation to be more user-driven. The first step is allowing the creator to switch to "custom mode" and chose the character the player will be when playing the game (created from Character Creator). This will set new players into your game at level 1 and save their character details along with the save file when they exit. Next step from that will be switching off random loot and allowing the creator to define which loot drops where, or perhaps the loot is a reward from a quest. Further steps on from that will let you name and set the stats of the loot. Further still will allow for individual tweaking of enemies to set their stats.

Massbot has returned from his journey into the Blighted lands and has created some content for this update (and will be continuing to work on RPG World alongside me). Haris, has also created a range of great items that will be appearing in various patches, the first item of which is a portal in today's patch.

The theme of this content update is giant vines! Nice and big to wrap around props and buildings, also includes an overgrown portal.

The patch notes can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/492150/discussions/0/1736594593602039151/]here[/url]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/58f2d3634399d4184479dc291d6ce72fb837df73.jpg[/img]

These are available if you've already purchased the Creative Pack.

See you soon.

notes.content:

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/956338348354028517/ED30539FF5DB76F92B3862D1CDC077697FDF7838/[/img]

notes.title: MyWorld Woodland Content Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/6eb56d62dabafe57888ab7044fa2887099302078.jpg[/img]
We felt it was about time to bring you a content update, adding more free content to the MyWorld universe and this time opting for a distinctly woodland theme, including a total of 29 new shape items that include ramps, walls, blocks and planks under a new 'shapes' tab in the game editor.

We also have some big ticket items for your players to discover as they explore the deeper woodlands including broken and shattered portals, a mysterious tree alter and a wrecked bridge.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/ff3bf6609593edca74108dd4a4f72c1f1dcf4cf7.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/2fba6287f3fe8a943d49456c70085c88f6628e06.jpg[/img]

If you do make it through the woods, we have created a nice table and chair set to rest during your adventure, and a light to keep the monsters at bay.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/eba81e07067266a9a6633be188af39c663612df6.jpg[/img]


We've also made some small fixes to the Samurai Temple doors so you can now lock them, and fixed the small hedges from the nature theme so they no longer suffer when a world is reloaded.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/c86fa3950b1d1bea8b1ae2c92670387e1fcccae9.jpg[/img]

You can read about all the updates in this version [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/492150/discussions/0/2949168687311633887/]HERE.[/url][/b]

Until next time we look forward to bringing you more exciting news and great features in the very near future.


Happy Creating!

notes.title: New patch is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/117df62f0cd4f04ed53e6542166496168b7d3c86.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Patch is live![/h1]
Our first update this year brings you the ability to save progress in games, an update to our built in worlds and some fixes.
Full update thread [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/492150/discussions/0/1700541698701009520/]>>here<<[/url]

[h1]Saving Game[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/2ad2ed8f64bd16c53248846bc880645589ab2390.jpg[/img]
Games created for Workshop can now be longer as progress when playing is stored. When exiting back to Hub World, the progress in the current game is stored and you will be given the option of carrying on where you left off the next time you play it. 

If the world happens to be one of your own and you go into edit mode, then the save file will be deleted, as you will likely be altering the world.

When playing a workshop game and in-between your last play the workshop files have changed (the Workshop game has been updated) then the save file will be removed.

Progress is also stored on any built-in games. Progress for your own games is not stored when you are creating them as you might save progress in one world and later edit another world in the same game, which would make the save file void. You have the advantage of going into any world you like in your own games of course and can still enjoy the progress saving when you upload the game to workshop.

[h1]Built in worlds[/h1]
Built in worlds were not doing a great job at show casing what MyWorld can do. So we've given them a big update!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/41d1a97dea47bd8f4087dc5e674f4b1dca5c0c57.jpg[/img]
The Blight has had the biggest makeover, it's been packed with all the features we put in last year. It's now longer, more action packed. has big group battles with NPC allies, story, treasure hunting, the lot. Give it a try by running through the main portal in HubWorld.

Happy creating

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/76c6f4beb28747337274582bcb815cb9b2dd4661.jpg[/img]

War has broken out in MyWorld with the introduction of Factions! Full update thread [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/492150/discussions/0/1483235412204720145/]>>here<<[/url]

[h1]Factions[/h1]
Any "enemy" whether stock or custom made can now be assigned a faction via the trusty Enemy Stash dialog (Click on the little bag above an enemy when in edit mode). 

There are 4 factions: Enemy 1 (default for all enemies) , Enemy 2, Enemy 3 and Player (all player characters are this faction).

All factions are hostile to the others, so for example Enemy 1 and Enemy 2 factions like nothing more than to pound each other into the ground. Any enemy on the Player faction will not attack players and cannot be hurt by players.

By default, enemies fighting each other will only do a small amount of damage to each other and never take another enemies health below half way. This allows for big battle scenes to take place and to keep on going, allowing the players to pick up the kills and get the loot. 

There is an option in the Enemy Stash, groups with the Factions called "Does full damage to non-players", if this is ticked then enemies will do normal damage to other enemies. This allows you to set up a "hero" scenario where one character will be substantially stronger than the others and overcome impossible odds - but also allows you to see how the fights play out, for example pitting 2 bosses (or more!) against each other. If an enemy is hit by another enemy that is doing full damage, that enemy will no longer yield any XP or a chance at loot for the player.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/1497406e087119006a96d93eae27d8b4eaf09edd.jpg[/img]  
Healers like the shaman will heal his own faction (assuming they are within range of his heal), but not the players, even if he is in the player faction. Similarly any player healing such as the Paladins heal, will only heal players and not other characters in the faction.

When an enemy is in a fight with another enemy and on a different faction to the player, they will mostly stick to fighting that enemy (unless they kill them, then they will look for another victim!), If the player gets very close though the enemy may well turn their attention to the player/s.
https://youtu.be/BlVjVAkiYSQ

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
As well as factions we also squeezed in some fixes:
- Turrets no longer shoot through walls or other objects
- Sound effects have been improved to not allow the same sound to be played lots of times at once
- Goblin Blaster explosion effects no longer has transparency issues

Let the battles begin! ːBuckeKnightː

notes.title: Latest Patch! Enemy spawn on quests and Enemy Respawns!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/70144e8c34a28506480aa4855b51da9afd421f00.jpg[/img]

This week brings you some spawn and re-spawn controls for enemies! Full update thread [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/492150/discussions/0/1480982971165949864/]>>here<<[/url]

[h1]Spawning enemies on quest[/h1]
When setting a quest you can now click "Pick enemies to spawn" and select one or more enemies that will only spawn when this quest is accepted. Clicking an already selected enemy will unselect them. You can also clear all selections back in the Quest editor by clicking "Clear enemies to spawn". In play mode these enemies will not be in the world until the quest that spawns them has been accepted. This allows for greater story telling as you could for example send the player out to hunt down enemies that have been attacking, only to find when he returns that the enemies are attacking the town itself. It also means you can reuse areas for different combat situations, perhaps hiding a boss until it is the right time to face them.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/d2260047c6d4228d2882dea8a186a310a4c8d0e2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Enemy Respawn times[/h1]
By default enemies do not respawn after being killed, but now in the enemy stash dialog, you can set the respawn time in minutes. 0 minutes means no respawn, 1 minute means the enemy will respawn 1 minute after being killed. There is also a button to copy the respawn setting to all enemies currently in the world "Copy time to all". Shift clicking to place a duplicate enemy will retain the respawn settings of the enemy you are duplicating.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/f3e2f39d45751d347f09821ad853debdb03f25f8.jpg[/img]

https://youtu.be/HIzt6cjdBZE

[h1]Next Week[/h1]
More exciting stuff coming next week, enemy factions so you can create experiences where you turn up to a location to find a battle already going on! Have a great weekend and keep making amazing stuff! ːBuckeKnightː

notes.title: Update time! - Keys and lockable doors
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/d200d90ff16fd1a72e4280eb8a713552aadf5118.jpg[/img]

[h1]Keys[/h1]
Todays update brings you keys and lockable doors. Keys can be given/received in three different ways:
Update thread [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/492150/discussions/0/1496741765130544756/]>>here<<[/url]

[h1]Place one into your world[/h1]
Keys can be found in the 'Game mechanics' tab (same one as portals / spawns etc). Click choose lock to bring up the keys settings.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/c8276a7eb8766d88fb0a432e9a6d2b93813d6ecc.jpg[/img]

[b]Name[/b] - This allows you to name the key so the player knows which door it's for. This name will be displayed in the new key section in your quest tracker (L).  If you don't add a custom name it'll be logged under the selected doors name.

[b]Select Door[/b] - Tick 'Unlocks door' and click the button to select which door you want the key to unlock. That door will be locked at the start of your game.

If a door is locked and a player doesn't have the key yet, when they try to run through it a locked sound will play. Once the key has been found, simply run through the door as normal, which will trigger a satisfying unlock sound. 

[h1]Key as rewards[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/e84ad4320b70bcc6c16d00bfa8d94af97b1451c4.jpg[/img]
Another way to give out a key, is to set is as a quest reward. Tick the box and hit the settings button to setup up the key in the same way as before. Once the quest is complete, the key will be given to the player and listed in the quest log.

[h1]Dropped by an enemy[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/8b3faa2ba7bd8e8bcdc260568d4777e6dc4b1487.jpg[/img]
The final way is we've extended the stash panel to allow you to add a key as an enemy drop.

[h1]Tracking Keys[/h1]
To track which keys you have, hit 'L' to bring up your quest tracker and click the key icon on the top right. Any used keys will be removed from the log.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/d03e0eecf27c6fe2bbb86e883bfef46faf640af7.jpg[/img]

Any door can be locked in MyWorld. We've added a couple more entrances that you can find in 'walls & fences' tab, along with the existing 'complete archway' doors, these will be great to lock off areas that require a key to progress.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/9314190888d8763a9a20fbc7ddfaa8d7db83291a.jpg[/img]

Checkout Ravey demoing the keys below.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=654v2z39v34&feature=youtu.be

Have a great weekend, happy building! ːVeteranGuardː

[h1]Quest update #3[/h1]
It's update o'clock! This weeks patch is now live. You can now set enemies to drop collectables and customise signs to give quests and dialogue. There's also lots of new items that have been added to the collectable tab. Full update thread [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/492150/discussions/0/2765630416809843806/]>>here<<[/url]

[h1]Enemy Stash[/h1]

When placing an enemy in edit mode, you'll notice there's a new button floating above their heads. Clicking this allows you to add up to 2 different types of collectables for them to drop inside a stash bag when killed. To open the bags, simply press 'U'. 
These drops will count towards any quests that use the collectables as a completion requirement. For example you could set a quest to collect 10 apples. 5 could be placed on the ground to find, and 5 could be placed in some goblin stashes (everyone knows goblins love apples..)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/33d830ef84704996eceb3e27e6800f8f799dbbe7.jpg[/img]

To work alongside the new stash feature, we've added a bunch of new collectables items, including ears, boots and buckles! 

[h1]Editable Signs[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/1675ba485ec2b3a18c6a00dee5ddfaaab7b54c5b.jpg[/img]
This has been requested a lot, so we are really happy to get this in!  Signs now act like NPC's in terms of quest and dialogue setting. Simply place one down and click it's quest button to edit.

notes.title: Latest Patch is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/703b9307be480e91985878fa4ad9f4435bfbc297.png[/img]
It's been a busy week, we've got lots of new additions to the quest system and portals. Also there is now a way to add a proper ending to your worlds. Check out all the new features below! Full update thread [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/492150/discussions/0/1474222595296229752/]>>here<<[/url]

[h1]New quest tab settings[/h1]
[u][b]'Quest ends with'[/b][/u]
Kill / collects quests can now be set to be completed with another NPC. Example below. 

[b]1.[/b]Thor has a quest set in his quest tab, buy clicking [b]'quest ends with'[/b] Borris has been selected as the completion target. This means when you complete Thor's quest, you have to hand it in with Borris.

[b]2.[/b]To set what Borris says when you hand in the quest, simply enter text into Thor's [b]'quest end'[/b] dialogue box

[b]2.[/b]Borris also has his own quests to give you, however these will be locked out and not show in your game until you have completed Thor's quest. This means you can set the pace at which quests are completed, by using [b]'quest ends with'.[/b] you can no longer simply run passed Thor and pickup Borris's quests. This is great for making sure stories are told in the order you want.

[b]3.[/b]NPC's must be named to be chosen as a a quest target.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/46bf2a2399ccb14217e65933ec4fde9bf6e32a1c.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/187f187d1653d974e78883037ba6d286d65957ef.jpg[/img]

[h1]Quests can unlock portals[/h1]
In a NPC's quest panel you can now set a quest to open a portal. Click the icon and simply select which portal you wish to unlock on quest completion. The portal effects will appear off until the quest is complete. Again, another great way of setting the pace of your world.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/f572cc254bd20be5b404f10e3d750559e297d2ed.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Portal settings[/h1]
You'll notice when placing a portal down, there is a new settings button. Clicking it brings up some exciting new options!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/49f964946df19ebb24cd633627a02c7101f07cb6.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Portal locked until..[/b][/u]
[b]Killed all enemies[/b] - This portal will not unlock until all enemies in the current world haven been killed. The player will receive a notification when this has been complete. This is great for gauntlet style worlds.

[b]Completed all quests [/b]- This portal will not unlock until all quests in the world have been complete. This option will be overwritten if an NPC has a quest that unlocks that portal. Again a notification will be given when this is complete.

These settings can be combined (so you have to kill all enemies and complete all quests to open the portal).

[b]Note[/b] - A quest that has been set to unlock a portal will override these 'portal locked until..' options.

[b]End game[/b] - Running through this portal will 'end the game'. It will trigger [b]end game text[/b] and [b]end game music[/b] (see below). 

[b]End game text [/b] - Click to change the text shown on the end game text, which shows as a scroll. After this appears in game you have the option to head back to HubWorld. If you are testing your level and run through an end game portal, you can hit escape to go back into edit mode (rather than having to go into HubWorld).
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/cfebb87e024b19f00cb9a64e6852a33234d6a7cd.jpg[/img]
[b]End game music[/b] - Click to change the music which is played during the end game text.

These portal settings combined with the new NPC quest settings means you now have a lot more power in how quests and your game is completed. You have the opportunity to add  real objectives and an ending to your worlds and stories. Looking forward to seeing what you all come up with!

[h1]Next Week[/h1]
Continuing with our quest updates, also there will be some more editor content ːBuckeKnightː

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/fc340680eae49fca6f98f62f87577e3630f7cc48.jpg[/img]
Todays update includes new built in worlds, an aim assist setting, fixes and bridges. Full thread [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/492150/discussions/0/1471966894866749600/]>>here<<[/url]

[h1]Bridges[/h1]
There's now a new tab in the editor, bridges! Click the icon to access 7 new bridge pieces, ranging from simple planks for walkways to a big suspension bridge. Like our other tabs, this one will continue to grow with content updates.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/ec33c072f4593161f351aa4f3edaebfc6ccdf59f.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/7fcaff3459849646c6bf92de2d979072c24b89c2.jpg[/img]

As well as spanning across terrain, they also stack like other objects, so they can be used to create floating walkways by linking them off other objects.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/a7b49522290278bf7ae2fc0e711117d01e3b43f8.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/fd6953bc07f9bb7fe5384bcf9cf3de6dfde231c5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Combat update[/h1]
Aim Assist has been added to the settings and is on by default. Hit F11 to turn off. This is great for newer users, or for those who like to run freely but want the benefits of locking on, aim assist will try and lock-on every time you swing your weapon. The lock lasts as long as the swing.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/83140b45d83c0605340b12dbf493708969045162.jpg[/img]

[h1]New games added into the main portal[/h1]
The top 3 worlds from our world building competition have been added into the main 'MyWorlds' portal. As a reminder they are,

[b]Arpee Geez by Aaron Steinmetz [/b]
[b]ORDER - DISOBEDIENCE - TURMOIL by Windebieste [/b]
[b]Farmer Fredrick's Feilds of Doom by Maxim Bowes [/b]

They are a great example of what can be done in MyWorld, and each offer a unique experience. If you haven't already played them via the workshop, then now is the time to jump through MyWorlds portal and get adventuring!

[h1]Next Week[/h1]
We've got some rather awesome multi level buildings in the works and Ravey will be continuing working on the combat, with questing not far behind. See you next week!

Happy building! ːGoblinBomberː

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/1e2a12d0288345882389f4c00aa2c30f2ec722bf.jpg[/img]
Full update thread -[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/492150/discussions/0/1291817208491386476/TOBEADDED]>>HERE<<[/url]

[h1]64 Bit[/h1]
MyWorld has levelled up and is now 64bit rather than 32bit! This should give an overall performance boost during your adventures.

[h1]Editor improvements[/h1]
Placing multiple objects into your world is now much quicker, whilst holding shift the new object now retains the previous placed objects rotation. Also when you press shift+r, it now adds 90' onto the [b]current[/b] rotation angle.

[h1]New Boss[/h1]
Today we are releasing our first new boss since release. He's the leader of the orc tribe. All hail the Orc Chieftain!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/fd5c2552a0ec01f38e5941c738296e5b5175c96a.jpg[/img]
The most aggressive boss we have in so far. He hits so hard the ground will rupture beneath your feet. You'll need to time your rolls carefully and pick the best openings for attacks to take him down. 
Apologies for not getting any new props/buildings etc into this build, the enemy creator and Mr Chieftain took up our time this week.

[h1]Enemy Creator[/h1]
For any newcomers to MyWorld this week, our current main task is the enemy creator. From last week's update here's some info on upcoming exciting new feature! -

The reason for the recent enemy updates is due to our current main task, the enemy creator. The more built in enemies we can give you, the more choice you'll have in the creator.
The creator will feature loads of new body parts to choose from (mix of our current enemies and lots of new models) including heads, arms, legs, torsos, weapons etc. All parts can be scaled up or down and recoloured. Left / Right arms and legs can be different too.

Stats can be assigned, damage, health and also choose which enemy ai and sounds are used. These can be saved out for use in your worlds, or shared on the workshop. More details will come as we push on with it.This is the first step in giving you unique control on how your worlds play and feel.

We can't give a release date just yet, but Ravey and I will be updating you in the coming weeks.

Have a great weekend, keep the feedback coming and happy creating.

[h1]New Boss[/h1]
Today we are releasing our first new boss since release. He's the leader of the orc tribe. All hail the Orc Chieftain!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/fd5c2552a0ec01f38e5941c738296e5b5175c96a.jpg[/img]

For any newcomers to MyWorld this week, our current main task is the enemy creator. From last week's update here's some info on upcoming exciting new feature! -

The reason for the recent enemy updates is due to our current main task, the enemy creator. The more built in enemies we can give you, the more choice you'll have in the creator.
The creator will feature loads of new body parts to choose from (mix of our current enemies and lots of new models) including heads, arms, legs, torsos, weapons etc. All parts can be scaled up or down and recoloured. Left / Right arms and legs can be different too.

Stats can be assigned, damage, health and also choose which enemy ai and sounds are used. These can be saved out for use in your worlds, or shared on the workshop. More details will come as we push on with it.This is the first step in giving you unique control on how your worlds play and feel.

We can't give a release date just yet, but Ravey and I will be updating you in the coming weeks.

Have a great weekend, keep the feedback coming and happy creating.

notes.title: MyWorld Competition Results
notes.content:
[h1]Competition Results[/h1]
*You hear trumpets sounding from above, perhaps you have taken one too many knocks on the head from a club skelly or perhaps it is the MyWorld Competition results!*
 
Yes I tried to go all RPG just then. Why? Because both Massy and myself have been blown away with the competition entries.
 
We wanted to play each and every one. It took us a while... a long while, but was it worth it? Absolutely!
 
We have seen things done with MyWorld that we never thought possible. Been on adventures that toyed with our morals. Laughed, been scared, been overwhelmed. In short we loved every moment, every carefully thought out story, every lovingly crafted world we visited.
 
Click the workshop link and hit subscribe to access the worlds in your workshop hub portals.
 
So without further rambling from me...onto the winners (no spoilers!):
 
[h1][u]Third Place:[/u][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/7a8d44f55f9453f5a2ed7f1182bf776b015cd81e.jpg[/img]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=900244274&searchtext=
We really felt like we were in this world, such great atmosphere, so well put together. Really enjoyed every moment.
 
[h1][u]Second Place:[/u][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/1e7f7ca2c8d95888e21ab4d9c69b3d9345451060.jpg[/img]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=913405590&searchtext=order
Very good level design, great story line. Do NOT go through the portal! Don't do it. No. The most amazing town we have seen in MyWorld. So detailed, so perfectly designed. Really great use of multiple worlds.
 
[h1][u]First Place:[/u][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/5a988b8c6ccee9b59ae1c1167d8745e66b30a551.jpg[/img]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=894982361&searchtext=geez
We could not help but smile throughout this game. We fell in love with the characters (one NPC in particular!), the drama, the suspense, the non-stop giggles. Really, really entertained us. Amazing fun.
 
An enormous well done and thank you to everyone who entered. We had so much fun and loved every moment. 
 
[h1][u]Honourable Mentions:[/u][/h1]
[h1]Sol Stones by Omnivoyance[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/9e7cd0cc47fa84384ef77b06b0a8c3e1439611b6.jpg[/img]
This one made our jaws drop. The ability to attach many different things in creative ways is used to the absolute max in this game. Really fun puzzles, really engaging world. Many moments that made us think "err.. is that possible in MyWorld?". Loved it. Really well done.
 
[h1]The Village of Kythis[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/be1a81e3fc329e8e4b571b8fe8dd344bae63c8b1.jpg[/img]
Some of my favourite visuals. Every prop and building has been carefully considered.
 
[h1]Wizard's End by Avatre[/h1]
Like an interactive book. Get a cup of tea and enjoy the journey.
 
[h1]Soul of lords by MistahBoweh[/h1]
Serious dark tone with good level design. Hopefully this world will be expanded in the future!
 
[h1]The 8 shards by TheStoryTeller[/h1]
Really big world with a lot of quests, consistent level design and theme.
 
[h1]Ocean Heights by wasdstomp[/h1]
Imaginative use of terrain for waves, etc. Some nice views!
 
[h1]Night Blight by Firebert[/h1]
Detailed night time town, really feels like you are battling through an old overrun castle. Big packs of skellys!
 
[h1]Jailbreak by Hemi Soolin[/h1]
Sense of dread smashing through the barricades, lots of quests to be found inside the town with some funny dialogue - love to try 'cart racing'. Good balance of collect and kill quests. The captain has a rather dirty secret :S  
 
[h1]damn u frodo by rudisaster[/h1]
Amazing world design, the twisting stairs are so cool, really clever stuff
 
[h1]The Inferno by IotcSalad[/h1]
Really enjoying the exploring and finding the route through. I never got lost thanks to great torch placement and being advised to look out for the torches.
 
[h1]Newport by benjiboy[/h1]
Love the water and the atmosphere of this place, I spent a lot of time standing looking out at the waves, really well put together
 
Visit the workshop [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/492150/workshop/]>>HERE<<[/url] to check out all the entries and share your own adventures.

notes.content:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/9386f07756e116c8c4eb8635ec94e27459f971cc.jpg[/img]
A new build is now live, including a whopping 34 new items to fill your worlds with and updates to loot. Checkout the images below and click [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/492150/discussions/0/1327844097117964228/]>>HERE<<[/url] for the full patch notes.

[h1]Loot update[/h1]
Thanks everyone for the feedback on our loot launch last week, it's been a great help. This new patch contains a lot of balancing and tweaks, which should create a better experience on venturing up in difficultly levels. Head over to the patch thread above for a full breakdown.

There has also been some visual imrpovements. The pop-up when opening a chest is a lot less intrusive and the inventory back panel has been polished up.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/63d79d3bec275555a3e4d2b5f2df56e6b523b672.jpg[/img]

[h1]Content Update[/h1]
Every week alongside our bigger picture tasks we strive to bring new content to fill your worlds with. If you have any prop idea's you like to see, please share them [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/492150/discussions/3/1319962683447895445/]>>HERE<<[/url]
This update sees a boost to most of the editor tabs, including a new sunset 'theme' shown in the header image. The header also features a pre-made alchemy table, but there are individual potions and scrolls to be placed too!

New table types and food items, including pies and eyeballs, yum. Decorative chests and beds are also now available.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/55bb0c6de3bd6f28009bc557ddb9b8735d85719f.jpg[/img]

Fill your spooky woods with some 'dead' variations of existing trees and the grand 'ancient tree'.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/cfb2de620cf2bc5f1146e96e88cdda45e30cba83.jpg[/img]

New wall styles and wall pillars to add variation to your towns. Also 3 new gothic style 'old ruin' buildings can be seen in the header image.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/d6a8ef98e60c7a89f9d6c5d63727966e95f1a631.jpg[/img]

Praise the sunset alongside some obelisks.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/362304f080a8ebaed6b8cffd2b779b9ad7442dd6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Development Update[/h1]
Our new main focus is on adding a character creator into MyWorld, The character creator will initially allow you to create and share your own unique enemies and NPCs. 
Customisation will include loads of body parts to mix and match from (which you can also re-colour and scale), choice of abilities, stat points, weapons, the lot! Characters can be saved out for your own worlds and shared on the workshop. During this time you'll also see new enemies that will cross over into the creator. 
We'll be updating our Development plan thread early next week with further details. As always we'll be bringing you regular editor content updates alongside this.

Thanks for everyone's continued feedback on the forums, happy building and have a great weekend ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Holy Protector - Tank.[/h1]
1.Taunt - Enemies close by are forced to attack you. You and party take 25% less damage.
2. Hilt Smash - Stuns enemies in front of you. The range has been increased.
3. Holy Buff - Large heal for yourself and party members.
4. Righteous Defence   - Reduces all damage for 20 seconds. 

[h1]Bucket Man High DPS, low health[/h1]
1. Sword spin - Damages all enemies around you, with bonus damage.
2. Ground slam - Damages enemies in front of you
3. Barrel hide - Bucket man hides in his barrel, recovering to full health!
4. Fury - Increases attack speed for 20 seconds.

[h1]Undead Slayer - Damage Dealer[/h1]
1. Sword spin - Damages all enemies around you, with bonus damage.
2. Ground slam - Damages enemies in front of you.
3. Poison Aura - Creates a bubble around you that causes damage.
4. Fury - Increases attack speed for 20 seconds.

notes.content:

[h1]Content and Development update[/h1]
A new build is now live! Highlights include new content to fill your worlds, improved combat, animations and even some Easter treats ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Content[/h1]
As always, alongside our longer term goals, which is currently the loot system we strive to bring you new editor items each week. This update has 15 new pieces, which includes some different style buildings, easter eggs and a chick critter! For the full list click [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/492150/discussions/0/135514287303525651/]>>>here<<<[/url]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/423a4b7baca18fc57812384f66e5b55e7c4570d0.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/ae9b792a97f08f50f0b1c5dd1b06376fc3b7f381.jpg[/img]

[h1]Combat upgrade[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SxHWu9EPEMI&feature=youtu.be
The latest MyWorld patch brings some big improvements to combat, where all animations and timings have been re-done to give the Knight classes a much weightier, fluid and faster response combat.
 
Now, rather than a warm up period for each attack, the strike happens straight away and instead has a recovering period at the end, which can be rolled out of or used to chain another attack.
 
Both the enemy and player have stagger resistance called "stance" which must be broken, giving the combat a much meatier feel. 
 
The heavy attack is now a double damage dealing leaping attack. Different sub classes have their own animations to make them feel more unique.
 
Hitting an enemy/object now halts player momentum, so the player still gains the benefit of covering ground when attacking, but with less risk of flying past the enemy.

[h1]Loot Update[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/63cd85a65912e7547f2fbc8e76298dffe2e8517e.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27697903/cbc8c05e0dd3e975cba15ac53ad0f347d9c7ef0a.jpg[/img]

Loot is coming in a few weeks time and brings with it 13 difficulty levels, different skills and abilities for the various Knight subclasses and of course a large amount of loot to collect. Loot will be able to drop from any kill, but will always drop from boss kills. Loot comprises of armour, weapons and rings and is graded from uncommon all the way up to legendary. Loot will also drop relevant to the current difficulty level, so if the same item were to drop at a higher level, it would be more powerful.
